coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and grooming
Preparing and eating breakfast, drinking extra water ahead of the hot day
Changing into work clothes, checking phone and packing work bag
Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
Taking a lunch break and rehydrating
Continuing clinical work and patient care on the ward
Washing up and changing into light, cool clothes
Preparing and eating a light cold dinner
Resting in the air-conditioned room and watching TV
Taking a cool shower to recover from the heat
Using the computer for personal tasks and winding down
